# `matchToResultOrOption`

Suggests Effect.result, Effect.option or Effect.either when match handlers, or a map step followed by a catch step, only reify the outcome

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377175` |
| Language Service name | `matchToResultOrOption` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/match-to-result-or-option` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Data, Effect, Result } from "effect"

class UserNotFound extends Data.TaggedError("UserNotFound")<{
  readonly id: string
}> {}

declare const fetchUser: (id: string) => Effect.Effect<{ readonly name: string }, UserNotFound>

// MUST TRIGGER: both handlers only reify the outcome, which is Effect.result
export const userResult = Effect.match(fetchUser("u1"), {
/**
                          ^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(match-to-result-or-option): `Effect.result` reifies the outcome directly; these `Effect.match` handlers only wrap the value and the error.
*/
  onFailure: (e) => Result.fail(e),
  onSuccess: (user) => Result.succeed(user)
})
```

```jsonc
          "matchToResultOrOption": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
